correctness.rationale: For integral filiform brackets Q_{2k}, coadjoint alternating matrix has one covector v=(lambda e3,..,lambda e2k) adjoining the middle nondegenerate skew form zJ, where z=lambda e2k and valuation b=nu(v)<=a=nu(z). Over any finite chain ring, a primitive symplectic-basis reduction turns v into pi^b in the first coordinate and leaves J standard; a 3x3 elementary shift removes the z coupling because pi^b divides z. Thus Smith skew blocks are pi^b J2 + (k-2) pi^a J2 + 0_2. Counting valuations of z and of n-3 other v entries proves all H_{a,b}, sum q^(sn), image q^(2e). The residue-characteristic p>2k-1 hypothesis makes the finite Lazard/Kirillov method applicable, giving orbit size q^(2e), degree q^e and multiplicities q^(-2e)*H. The symplectic reduction remains valid in characteristic two; character statement is conditional.
